title: Polarity coupling in biphasic electrolytes enables iodine/polyiodide co-extraction for portable Zn–iodine batteries following a liquid–liquid conversion route
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,7447-7459
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE02593A, Paper
Hai Xu, Ruanye Zhang, Derong Luo, Kangsheng Huang, Jiuqing Wang, Gengzhi Sun, Hui Dou, Xiaogang Zhang
A biphasic (BP) electrolyte system composed of two immiscible solutions of Zn(TFSI)2 in EA and ZnSO4/KI in water is designed to address the key issues existing in Zn–iodine batteries.
